title: Monkey Map
description: Navigate a map with flat wrapping and cube-surface wrapping.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the map and path instructions (steps and turns). Simulate movement with direction tracking.

## Part 1

When stepping off the edge, wrap around to the opposite side of the row or column (skipping spaces). The password is `1000 * row + 4 * col + facing`.

## Part 2

The map is a cube net. Assign each face a 3D orientation (normal, up, right vectors) via BFS over adjacent faces. When stepping off a face edge, use the 3D orientations to determine which face you land on and how the coordinate system rotates. Edge positions are mapped using the 3D edge-direction vectors to handle arbitrary net layouts.
